title: Direct calls can wait
summary: In a direct call, the caller waits for a reply. This is simple to follow but the caller depends on the other service responding.
introduction: In a direct call, the caller waits for a reply. This is simple to follow but the caller depends on the other service responding. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question
